cc:Work.dc:title: Conceptual unnormalized phase separation
cc:Work.dc:description: Analytical toy: phase_j=2pi*j/5; f_j=3+cos(phase_j)+0.5 sin(phase_j); weights=[1,cos,sin]; outputs=[15,2.5,1.25]. Not a reconstruction result.
